import base64, json, os, runpy, sys
import google.auth
from google.auth.transport.requests import AuthorizedSession
creds, _ = google.auth.default(scopes=["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"])
r = AuthorizedSession(creds).get("https://secretmanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/food-crisis-modeling-enso/secrets/mlflow-jobwriter/versions/1:access", timeout=60)
r.raise_for_status()
c = json.loads(base64.b64decode(r.json()["payload"]["data"]))
os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_USERNAME"], os.environ["MLFLOW_TRACKING_PASSWORD"] = c["username"], c["password"]
module, sys.argv = sys.argv[1], [sys.argv[1]] + sys.argv[2:]
runpy.run_module(module, run_name="__main__", alter_sys=True)
